excluded_case: datagrok: base #4 is unavailable in the unchanged enforced output schema
control: Previously completed full zero-tool and catalog-only calls in real-fix-probe-v1 and real-fix-cross-model-v1; no control calls rerun
schedule: Sol schedule filtered to five cases and full, preserving order; hosts run sol, astra, claude sequentially

scanner.root: Each packet's named spec file; already supplied context remains available for provenance
scanner.normalization: Replace the exact temporary workspace prefix with a dot in model-visible stdout/stderr only; save exact raw bytes and both digests locally
scanner.incomplete_policy: Exit outside 0/1, missing complete Summary, INCOMPLETE, absent required tier, timeout, source mutation or scanner mutation aborts before model calls; no truncation, retries, raised ceilings, or alternate roots

prompt_control: Original full prompt and unchanged catalog-only comparator prompt must match their historical SHA-256 for every case/side and host. Append only a fixed evidence-boundary paragraph and the complete normalized scanner stdout/stderr to the full prompt. Source and enforced schema identities remain exact; record base, comparator and augmented prompt digests.
source_control: Reuse v9/v10 staging, upstream Git-blob validation, source SHA-256, and unchanged scoring; validate staged source/skill bytes before and after each scanner and model invocation
primary_metric: Paired change in strict BEFORE target detection against historical catalog-only and historical full zero-tool, one vote per source-repair cluster, reported separately per model
secondary_metrics: per-case gained/lost/unchanged target hits against each control
scanner elapsed time separately from summed model call time
scanner target-line candidates and duplicate or missing candidates; candidate presence is not semantic correctness
decision_rule: Descriptive only: report all five paired outcomes per model and all mapped AFTER alarms; no significance, population-effect, product superiority, or release PASS claim
model_failure_policy: Stop on first missing usage, schema violation, source/prompt drift, bad return code, or incomplete structured output. Preserve the failed call locally; no retries, replacements, or imputation.
limitations: Historical controls introduce a temporal/provider-state confound even with identical CLI versions and model names
Five selected public model-adjudicated repair clusters and one repetition are not a sealed or population benchmark
Scanner evidence is precomputed; model calls have no tools, so this is not the full interactive skill workflow
Only mapped AFTER locations are scored; other findings are unadjudicated and whole-report precision is unknown
Tokens and elapsed time are descriptive within-host metrics, not cross-host billing comparisons
Raw reports, exact scanner output and source packets remain in a local cache; public hashes alone are not independently replayable evidence
